Anonymous usage stats

This site sends anonymous stats to PostHog (US) to help improve the app: a random ID stored only in this browser, room and rig dimensions and setup, which features you used, errors, browser language and time zone, and screen size. Your name, contact details and IP location are not sent. You can turn this off in Menu › Settings › “Send anonymous usage stats”.
